Tank versus damage

Attack is only half the story. A Ground Pal with high defense and HP survives longer in tower fights, while a pure attacker clears open-world camps faster. For raids and tower bosses, mix one high-defense Ground Pal into the party so the AI absorbs hits while your damage dealers work. Element matchups matter too — Ground is strong against the elements it counters and weak against its own counters, so check the target before you commit a team.

Frequently asked questions

What is the strongest Ground Pal?

Anubis has the highest base attack among Ground Pals at 130.

How many Ground Pals are there?

44 Pals in the current data have the Ground element.

Which Ground Pal has the most defense?

Aegidron leads with 140 base defense.

Is a monotype Ground team viable?

Yes for most content, but a single element team gets punished by its counter. Bring one off-element Pal for tower fights.
